en: Color image of a seaside resort: in the foreground is a low stone wall with three white penguin statues and colorful flower beds behind them. To the left stands a rustic stone building with arched openings and a red-tiled roof. Behind it, a modern mid‑century hotel block rises near the shoreline. On the right are a sandy beach, parasols, and small boats along a calm blue sea under a clear sky.
